name: Link Checker and Directory Overview

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # daily

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true
          pip install pytest

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest -q

      - name: Create lychee config
        run: |
          cat <<EOF > lychee.toml
          [ignore]
          patterns = ["https://dynamic-svg-service.com/*"]
          EOF

      - name: Run lychee
        uses: lycheeorg/lychee-action@v1
        with:
          config: lychee.toml
          path: .

      - name: Generate directory overview
        run: |
          echo "## Directory Overview" > dir_overview.md
          echo "" >> dir_overview.md
          echo "| Directory | Files |" >> dir_overview.md
          echo "|-----------|-------|" >> dir_overview.md
          for dir in $(find . -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name '.' ! -name '.github'); do
            count=$(find "$dir" -type f | wc -l)
            echo "| $(basename "$dir") | $count |" >> dir_overview.md
          done
          if grep -q "<!-- DIRECTORY_OVERVIEW -->" README.md; then
            sed -i '/<!-- DIRECTORY_OVERVIEW -->/r dir_overview.md' README.md
          else
            echo "" >> README.md
            echo "## Directory Overview" >> README.md
            cat dir_overview.md >> README.md
          fi
          rm dir_overview.md

      - name: Commit README changes
        if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git diff --quiet || (git add README.md && git commit -m "Update directory overview" && git push)
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
